changes_made.explanation: The paper does not actually address NLG tasks. It introduces TTE depth as a statistical analysis tool for text embeddings and applies it to analyze existing datasets (both human-written and synthetic), but does not generate or evaluate NLG outputs. The paper evaluates the TTE depth metric itself, not NLG systems.
The Q parameter, W statistic, and p-value are statistical test results for TTE depth, not metrics for evaluating NLG outputs. The paper does not use any automatic metrics to evaluate generated text.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate generated outputs in this paper.
No human evaluations of generated outputs are conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper introduces TTE depth as a statistical tool for analyzing text embeddings distributions. It applies this tool to analyze existing datasets (including synthetic ones) but does not actually generate or evaluate NLG outputs. The paper's focus is on the statistical analysis method itself, not on NLG evaluation. The original extraction incorrectly interpreted the paper as addressing NLG tasks when it actually focuses on embedding space analysis.
